successes: The Anthropic research was pinned to the window by the official X post timestamp and read in full on the Alignment Science Blog.

failures: arXiv API returned 0 results for the window, so no arXiv candidates.
The Anthropic blog page carries only a month (October 2026), so its publishedAt is null; the in-window date relies on the X announcement.
The interactive dataset map and figures were not inspected; no code or monitor prompt is public, so nothing was reproduced (codeStatus not_run).
Several candidates were judged from X posts only (CaPtain, PlanAssist, Super Decider, Mysuru speech model).
X post retrievedAt timestamps were not captured per call, so they are null.
lessonsLearned: Check Hugging Face createdAt for every model announced on X: in-window posts often cover releases from earlier days.
